# ejukebox.music
# A real robots.txt in the repo, which overrides the one-line file
# jekyll-sitemap generates when none exists. That generated file had a
# Sitemap: line and no User-agent group at all, which several validators
# flag and which leaves nowhere to state intent.
#
# Everything on this site is meant to be crawled. No Disallow rules on
# purpose - blocking /assets/img/ would keep the venue photography out of
# Google Images, which is free distribution we want.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://ejukebox.music/sitemap.xml
